 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Uniform nonzero row is the divider; objects settle toward it.
    divider = next(r for r in range(h) if all(v == grid[r][0] and v != 0 for v in grid[r]))
    color = grid[divider][0]
    occupied = [[False]*w for _ in range(h)]
    comps = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] and grid[r][c] != color and not occupied[r][c]:
                col = grid[r][c]
                stack = [(r,c)]; occupied[r][c] = True; cells=[]
                while stack:
                    y,x=stack.pop(); cells.append((y,x))
                    for yy,xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                        if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and not occupied[yy][xx] and grid[yy][xx]==col:
                            occupied[yy][xx]=True; stack.append((yy,xx))
                comps.append((cells,col))
    # Move the components nearest the divider first so they block those behind.
    toward_down = divider == 0
    comps.sort(key=lambda item: (min(r for r,c in item[0]) if toward_down else -max(r for r,c in item[0])))
    out = [[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    out[divider] = [color]*w
    for cells,col in comps:
        step = 1 if toward_down else -1
        shift=0
        while True:
            nr=[r+step*(shift+1) for r,c in cells]
            if min(nr)<0 or max(nr)>=h or divider in nr:
                break
            if any(out[r+step*(shift+1)][c] != 0 for r,c in cells):
                break
            shift += 1
        for r,c in cells:
            out[r+step*shift][c]=col
    return out
